content:
Hello folks,
I've been working on formalizing the Projective Tensor Product, following the book H. H. Schaefer and M. P. Wolff, Topological Vector Spaces (p. 93). I've defined it using the universal property and also showed the construction by constructing 0-neighborhood basis using absolutely convex hulls. The result of the work is PR #42127. I wanted to ask if anyone would like to take a look an maybe provide some feedback. I think there are many directions, we can take it from here. I was particularly interested in defining nuclear spaces and proving the spectral theorem for Rigged Hilbert Spaces (which is still a long way, but I think it's a step in the right direction).
